5 Bond Street
Overview
Contact us
A base for modern business in Melbourne's east

Occupying a prime corner position on Bond Street in central Ringwood, this all-electric commercial building offers nine levels of A-grade office space with direct access to Eastland's unparalleled retail and hospitality amenities. Designed to meet the highest sustainability standards, it sets a new benchmark for suburban workplaces.

The Fender Katsalidis-designed property provides exceptional connectivity by road, rail, or bus, along with four levels of secure car parking and thoughtfully designed end-of-trip facilities. Delivering vital services, employees of Eastern Health, the Department of Families, Fairness and Housing, as well as training organisation MEGT, will benefit from this strategic location just 23km from Melbourne’s CBD and mere steps from the accommodation and conference amenities of Sage Hotel Ringwood.

Work and wellbeing truly intersect at 5 Bond Street, with Greenwood Park and Stanley Gardens only a short stroll away, views over the award-winning Ringwood Town Square, and Eastland’s gyms, dining venues and entertainment directly opposite.
